preregistered_item: Case inclusion/exclusion, canonical category and language; 8 cases/2 per category
Legal identity and permission to review/transform each case text
Primary source packet version, as-of dates and actual locator list
Counterfactual candidate/comparator factual equivalence and author separation
No K evidence roles promoted from caption/index/context to causal efficacy
A1-RUBRIC-mapping v0.1 proposal locked against original four-category weights
Text-level speakability only; actual audio-prosody explicitly NOT_OBSERVED
Storyboard semantic alignment only; real video sync explicitly NOT_OBSERVED
Four-to-eight separate calibration and true-negative / legitimate N/A fixtures
Critical factual severity definitions and NOT_CHECKABLE versus 0 distinctions
Two independent domain reviewers per case, conflict and fluency screen
Independent bilingual meaning check only if owner-cleared pair exists
Authorless blind labels and secret mapping key, protected by non-rater steward
Counterbalanced presentation order; reviewer exposure trace
Separate sources needed to verify claims remain visible; no fake source blinding
Predefined randomization seed or deterministically archived ordering rule
Frozen raw forms before discussion, timestamp/immutable version control
Predeclared agreement table, subgroup stats, small-n caveat, NA handling
Predefined severity escalation, immediate stops and replacement policy
No measurement labels for viewer retention, actual listening or natural audio
Risk-aware data access, retention, deletion and audit log
Signed Director execution authorization listing actual named packets and people
